strings.随机选择目标发射射线造成法术伤害: Fires a beam at a randomly chosen target, dealing Arts damage
strings.【灭顶之灾】选择攻击力最高的干员对其发射一枚<刺胄之弹>，<刺胄之弹>到达目标位: [Cataclysm] Fires an <Armor Piercer> at the operator with the highest ATK; when the <Armor Piercer> reaches the target position it explodes, stunning the target and the units in the 8 surrounding tiles for a long time and dealing Physical damage to them every second; attacking the <Armor Piercer> several times while it is in flight will destroy it
strings.生命值低于一定比例时，受到的物理与法术伤害降低，【灭顶之灾】额外发射<刺胄之弹>: When HP falls below a certain percentage, takes reduced Physical and Arts damage, and [Cataclysm] fires an additional <Armor Piercer>
strings.【旧日的剑与锤】在模拟中达成特定条件并进入隐秘核心回合时，<假想敌：胄>将获得<: [Sword and Hammer of Old] When specific conditions are met in the simulation and the Hidden Core round is entered, <OpFor: Armor> appears in its full form together with <'Armor Cleaver'> and <'Armor Crusher'>
strings.<“斩胄之剑”>和<“破胄之锤”>初始无敌；被击落时受到伤害以一定比例传递给<假: <'Armor Cleaver'> and <'Armor Crusher'> start out Invulnerable; once shot down, a certain percentage of the damage they take is passed on to <OpFor: Armor>
strings.<“斩胄之剑”>和<“破胄之锤”>周期性飞向场上攻击力最低的一名干员并自爆，使目: <'Armor Cleaver'> and <'Armor Crusher'> periodically fly to the operator with the lowest ATK on the field and self-destruct, stunning the target and the operators in the 8 surrounding tiles and dealing Physical damage to them every second, then return to <OpFor: Armor>'s side; they lose Invulnerability in flight and are shot down after taking a certain number of hits; once shot down, they count as ground units and take increased damage
strings.优先攻击防御力最高的单位: Prioritizes attacking the unit with the highest DEF
strings.对同一个目标进行攻击时，攻击速度逐渐提升: ASPD gradually increases while attacking the same target
strings.【最终之罚】停止攻击，移动速度大幅提升，向全场防御力最高的单位冲锋。对经过的单位: [Final Punishment] Stops attacking, greatly increases its Movement Speed, and charges at the unit with the highest DEF on the field. Deals Physical damage to units it passes
strings.【未尽的告解】在模拟中达成特定条件并进入隐秘核心回合时，场上出现<“碎铳之簧”>: [Incomplete Confession] When specific conditions are met in the simulation and the Hidden Core round is entered, <'Gunshatter Spring'> appears on the field and the Physical and Arts damage taken by <OpFor: Gun> is greatly reduced
strings.【盲信之誓】与场上所有<“碎铳之簧”>连结，<“碎铳之簧”>受到伤害时以一定比例: [Vow of Blind Faith] Links with every <'Gunshatter Spring'> on the field; when a <'Gunshatter Spring'> takes damage, a certain percentage of it is passed on to <OpFor: Gun>; allied units standing on a [Vow of Blind Faith] link take Physical damage every second
strings.【末日布道】持续召唤场上所有<“碎铳之簧”>向自身移动，<“碎铳之簧”>移动速度: [Doomsday Sermon] Continuously summons every <'Gunshatter Spring'> on the field to move toward itself; the <'Gunshatter Spring'> units' Movement Speed is greatly increased and they are immune to damage, and they deal Physical damage to allied units they pass
strings.在场时持续召唤【暗色的喟叹】形态<“余音”>；生命值低于一定比例时，召唤间隔缩短: While on the field, continuously summons <'Lingering Tone'> in the [Dusky Sigh] form; when HP falls below a certain percentage, the summoning interval is shortened
strings.优先攻击【暗色的喟叹】形态<“余音”>: Prioritizes attacking <'Lingering Tone'> in the [Dusky Sigh] form
strings.【裂管之奏】选择场上所有【暗色的喟叹】形态<“余音”>进行一次三连击，造成范围法: [Cracked Pipe Recital] Selects every <'Lingering Tone'> in the [Dusky Sigh] form on the field and performs a three-hit combo, dealing area Arts damage and Necrosis Damage
strings.在模拟中达成特定条件并进入隐秘核心回合时，<假想敌：弦>将与<假想敌：管>同时登: When specific conditions are met in the simulation and the Hidden Core round is entered, <OpFor: String> appears together with <OpFor: Pipe>
strings.同时攻击防御最高的两个单位: Attacks two units with the highest DEF simultaneously
strings.【大潮】对所有我方单位造成法术和神经损伤: [Great Tide] Deals Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to all allied units
strings.【崩坍】对若干我方单位造成物理伤害: [Collapse] Deals Physical damage to multiple allied units
strings.【断裂生殖】召唤子代缠绕我方单位使其晕眩: [Fragmentation] Summons its offspring to entwine themselves around allied units and Stun them
strings.【物种爆发】战斗经过较长时间后扣除所有目标生命: [Species Outbreak] Drains all Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle
strings.未被阻挡时有几率闪避物理与法术攻击，被阻挡时可以快速移动至其身后并在原地留下一个: Has a chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks when not blocked. When blocked, swiftly moves behind the target and leaves an <Ominous Apparition> at the original location
strings.会使用技能对周围造成物理伤害，攻击和技能无视目标一定防御力且额外造成神经损伤: Can use skills to deal Physical damage to the surrounding area; attacks and skills ignore a certain amount of DEF and inflict Nervous Impairment
strings.阿利斯泰尔，帝国余晖: Alistair, Final Flame of the Empire
strings.生命值降至一半及以下时，防御力及法术抗性提升，【莫非王土】每次活化两件装备: When HP drops to half or below, DEF and RES increase, and [Sovereign Domain] awakens two pieces of gear each time
strings.【斥退】战斗经过较长时间后，对全场我方单位造成法术溅射伤害, 并扣除所有目标生命: [Rebuke] After a long time has passed in the battle, deals Arts splash damage to all allied units on the field and drains all targets' Life Points
strings.【王权号令】锁定一个我方单位及其周围四格，对范围内目标造成一次高额物理伤害并在此: [Royal Command] Locks onto one allied unit and the four tiles around it, dealing heavy Physical damage once to targets in the area and generating random gear on the tiles within it
strings.【莫非王土】场上存在装备时，使一件装备活化，不同的装备将产生不同效果。: [Sovereign Domain] While gear is on the field, awakens one piece of gear; different gear produces different effects.
